snippet.title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii | Ichiban Special Outfit Set Pre-Order Bonus
snippet.description:
Pre-order Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii to get the ability to have Majima change into two of Ichiban Kasuga's iconic outfits.

Releasing February 21, 2025! 
PlayStation®5 / PlayStation®4 / Xbox Series X|S / Xbox One / Windows / Steam
